column1: # test/java/speed-measured.tsv (GTS208 (a), doc/GATE-SURVEY.md): the quiet CPU time of each test that timed out,
# measured by `bin/java-speed record LEVEL CPU-LOG` from a rerun with ARBACE_CPU_LOG (bin/java-speed rerun).
# ID<TAB>LEVEL<TAB>STATUS<TAB>CPU-SECONDS<TAB>LIMIT<TAB>VERDICT: per test the slowest action's CPU (user+system), the worst
# exit status (137 killed by the limit), the line for test/java/timeouts.txt (2.5 times the CPU over limited's 5, at least 20),
# and java-check's verdict of the rerun (pass, differ, fail, timeout, ...; "none" when the results have no row).
# A :speed test has a row here with STATUS 0 and VERDICT pass (then it leaves the class and passes at its limit); one that
# finishes with another verdict goes to a behaviour class; one that does not finish within 600 s of CPU, to :speed-hang.
# Measured: the reruns of 2026-11-03/04 (bin/java-speed rerun interp, 50 tests; rerun compiled, 14), recorded 2026-11-04.
